# Kern picker — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for Kern picker when choosing is the task and one component should cover every shape of it: sheets, dialogs and selects unified behind modes with per-mode panels. `mode` picks what is being chosen — date, time, date-time, country, option-list, assignee, status, plan — and `variant` picks where it renders: dialog, bottom sheet, or the anchored inline popover. The option list is a listbox where each option reports selected state and is named by its label alone, with multi-select marking the listbox multiselectable; single-select closes on pick while multi-select stays open and reports the array. `trigger`, `panel` and `footer` slot the opener, the per-mode body and the footer actions, `catalog` feeds plan mode through the service-catalog adapter, and countries are consumer-supplied because Kern ships no country dataset. The select, combobox and autocomplete stay the entry primitives — the picker composes them per mode rather than replacing closed-list, filter-as-you-type or free-text usage — and the calendar stays single-date, with range landing later.

## Native

### Features

Reach for Kern picker when choosing is the task and one component should cover every shape of it: sheets, dialogs and selects unified behind modes with per-mode panels — the native twin under the same contract. `mode` picks what is being chosen — date, time, date-time, country, option-list, assignee, status, plan — and `variant` picks where it renders: centred dialog, bottom sheet, or the inline non-modal list. The option set announces as a checkbox group or radiogroup under the picker's label with each option reporting its checked state; single-select closes on pick while multi-select stays open and reports the array. `trigger`, `panel` and `footer` slot the opener, the per-mode body and the footer actions, `catalog` feeds plan mode through the service-catalog adapter, and countries are consumer-supplied because Kern ships no country dataset. The select, combobox and autocomplete stay the entry primitives — the picker composes them per mode rather than replacing closed-list, filter-as-you-type or free-text usage — and the calendar stays single-date, with range landing later.
